description:
Twenty-year-old Yeo Yijae was forced to be born a girl due to a hereditary curse of “misfortune” passed down through the family.

Meanwhile, Myo Seungje, the second son of a divine spirit, was born with black fur, the symbol of misfortune, and became the unwanted outcast of his household.

For unlucky Yijae and Seungje, the embodiment of misfortune, the keyword to changing their fate is marriage?!

---
